verdicts.summary: Concurrent full and per-thread sweeps can both dispatch auto-settle for one thread, but the Orchestrator rejects the second dispatch.
verdicts.scenario: A full sweep and a per-thread sweep both pick the same thread candidate and both dispatch thread.auto-settle. The first settles it. The second finds settledOverride set, or updatedAt newer than snapshotAt, and fails. That failure is caught per group and logged, so it neither double-settles nor aborts the rest of the sweep.

verdicts.summary: The close-command map is cleaned up on terminal runs, and per-command dedupe by item id holds.
verdicts.scenario: A close command ends and refreshes immediately. Repeat updates of the same item id are skipped by ended.has. A late item update after the run ended re-creates an entry, which only causes one extra read at the next run end. A command still active adds an entry and does not refresh.

verdicts.summary: The gate cancels on any not-settled observation and re-arms when the same completion settles again.
verdicts.scenario: A thread is settled, then briefly not settled, then settled again with the same completedAt. The unsettled observation cancels the timer. The later settled observation sees at greater than handled and starts a fresh timer. A completion that was already notified is not repeated.

verdicts.summary: The tracker side bumps the version and notifies listeners on expiry. I did not open the Sidebar clockKey or the mobile useMemo wiring.
verdicts.missing: Sidebar.tsx:384-527 and useThreadListV2.ts:58-106 were not read in this session, so I could not check that they recompute on the version bump.

verdicts.summary: If observe runs after the deadline but before the timer fires, it ends the hold itself and stamps the return time.
verdicts.scenario: The timer is delayed, for example by a backgrounded tab, and observe runs at a time at or after the deadline. The working flag becomes false and returns is set at line 220. A backwards clock jump only lengthens the hold, and schedule re-arms.

verdicts.summary: The deadline is reused from the previous state, so repeat observes cannot extend it.
verdicts.scenario: observe is called repeatedly while the thread is held. The deadline is reused via previous.deadline, so the hold ends at the original deadline. The placement keys include activeOrderKey, which only the user's manual ordering sets, so it cannot cancel the grace when a run finishes.
